mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential demand, which typically signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in manufacturing production (INDPRO) below 105 signals a supply-side contraction that disrupts corporate supply chains and reduces earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%) typically leads to central bank tightening and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0% annualized) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer and housing demand, which typically boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS rising and HOUST rising fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment above 4.0% signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns during recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0.
